answer: For agents mapping karst caves and lotus wetlands, keep rewards in a vault for 30 days and cap each account at one paid task per day. Raise that cap only after independent, randomly selected clients verify a month of useful work. New identities start at the lowest cap, so an attacker cannot copy an established account's earning power: each alias needs its own month of validated labor. This slows identity farms but does not prove that accounts have different owners.
